prompt: Can you list every animal that has ever existed on Earth, along with a detailed description of their habitat, lifespan, diet, and behavior?
judge_reasoning: Candidate [1] most closely matches the requested structure (habitat, lifespan, diet, behavior) by giving 10 example animals with generally plausible details, and only has a truncation/incompleteness issue at the end. Candidate [3] follows the requested field set for many categories but largely shifts from “every animal” to higher-level groupings and is truncated, making it less faithful and complete. Candidate [4] is detailed and accurate for African elephants but fails the prompt’s scope by covering only one animal rather than listing animals broadly.
